name: Hisagi Neurology
description: Hisagi Neurology is a block theme for a small outpatient neurology clinic that explains a symptom before it orders a scan. A pale cool ground carries one stadium-shaped window holding a documentary photograph, with a row of pastel vertical capsules crossing it like a nerve-conduction trace. A symptom disc stays pinned with hairline callouts while a narrow column of symptoms passes beside it, white label strips and a drifting ghost word run through the page, and a floating booking card stays at the bottom right. Manrope for headings, Figtree for reading. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German. Works without WooCommerce. WCAG AA colours.
